title: अष्टाविंशत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 128 · Shiva teaches the dharma of the four orders

summary.en: Shiva tells the origin of Tilottama, made by Brahma from tiny bits of jewels, and Uma asks him of the dharma of the orders. Shiva speaks of the duty of each order, the householder who keeps hospitality, the three fires, offerings and animal rites, and says that this is the whole of the dharma of each of the four orders.
summary.kn: ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ರತ್ನಗಳ ತುಂಡುಗಳಿಂದ ತಿಲೋತ್ತಮೆಯನ್ನು ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸಿದ ಕಥೆ ಶಿವ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಉಮೆ ವರ್ಣಧರ್ಮ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಣದ ಕರ್ತವ್ಯ, ಅತಿಥಿವ್ರತ ಗೃಹಸ್ಥ, ತ್ರೇತಾಗ್ನಿ, ಇಷ್ಟಿ, ಪಶುಬಂಧ ಇತ್ಯಾದಿ ನಾಲ್ಕು ವರ್ಣಗಳ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಧರ್ಮ ಎಂದು ಶಿವ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: शिव ब्रह्मा द्वारा रत्नकणों से तिलोत्तमा की रचना की कथा कहते हैं, और उमा वर्णधर्म पूछती हैं। शिव प्रत्येक वर्ण का कर्तव्य, अतिथिव्रती गृहस्थ, तीन अग्नियाँ, इष्टि और पशुबन्ध बताते हैं और कहते हैं कि यह चारों वर्णों का सम्पूर्ण धर्म है।
summary.te: బ్రహ్మ రత్న కణాలతో తిలోత్తమను సృష్టించిన కథను శివుడు చెబుతాడు; ఉమ వర్ణ ధర్మాన్ని అడుగుతుంది. ప్రతి వర్ణం కర్తవ్యం, అతిథివ్రతుడైన గృహస్థుడు, త్రేతాగ్నులు, ఇష్టులు, పశుబంధాలు నాలుగు వర్ణాల పూర్తి ధర్మమని శివుడు అంటాడు.
summary.ta: பிரம்மன் ரத்தினத் துகள்களால் திலோத்தமையைப் படைத்த கதையைச் சிவன் கூற, உமை வருண தர்மம் பற்றிக் கேட்கிறாள். ஒவ்வொரு வருணத்தின் கடமை, விருந்தோம்பல் நோன்பு இல்லறத்தான், மூன்று நெருப்புகள், இஷ்டிகள், பசுபந்தம் நான்கு வருணங்களின் முழு தர்மம் என்கிறார்.
summary.ml: രത്നങ്ങളുടെ ചെറിയ അംശങ്ങളിൽനിന്ന് ബ്രഹ്മാവ് സൃഷ്ടിച്ച തിലോത്തമയുടെ ഉത്ഭവം ശിവൻ പറയുന്നു; നാല് വർണ്ണങ്ങളുടെ ധർമ്മം ഉമ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. ഓരോ വർണ്ണത്തിന്റെയും കടമ, അതിഥി സൽക്കാരം പാലിക്കുന്ന ഗൃഹസ്ഥൻ, മൂന്ന് അഗ്നികൾ, യാഗങ്ങൾ, മൃഗബലി എന്നിവയെക്കുറിച്ച് ശിവൻ സംസാരിക്കുന്നു; ഇത് നാല് വർണ്ണങ്ങളിൽ ഓരോന്നിന്റെയും ധർമ്മത്തിന്റെ പൂർണ്ണരൂപമാണെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.128; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: महेश्वर उवाच

meaning.en: Maheshvara said:

verses.text:
तिलोत्तमा नाम पुरा ब्रह्मणा योषिदुत्तमा ।
तिलं तिलं समुद्धृत्य रत्नानां निर्मिता शुभा ॥

meaning.en: Long ago Brahma fashioned an excellent woman named Tilottama, gathering a tiny bit from each of the jewels, and she was lovely.

verses.text:
साभ्यगच्छत मां देवि रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि ।
प्रदक्षिणं लोभयन्ती मां शुभे रुचिरानना ॥

meaning.en: Goddess, she came to me, unmatched in beauty on earth, circling me to the right and trying to tempt me, that fair-faced one.

verses.text:
यतो यतः सा सुदती मामुपाधावदन्तिके ।
ततस्ततो मुखं चारु मम देवि विनिर्गतम् ॥

meaning.en: Wherever that fine-toothed woman ran near me, in that direction a lovely face of mine appeared, goddess.

verses.text:
तां दिदृक्षुरहं योगाच्चतुर्मूर्तित्वमागतः ।
चतुर्मुखश्च संवृत्तो दर्शयन्योगमात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Wishing to see her, I took on four forms through yoga, and became four-faced, displaying my own yogic power.

verses.text:
पूर्वेण वदनेनाहमिन्द्रत्वमनुशास्मि ह ।
उत्तरेण त्वया सार्धं रमाम्यहमनिन्दिते ॥

meaning.en: With my eastern face I govern the rule of Indra; with the northern one, blameless lady, I take my delight with you.

verses.text:
पश्चिमं मे मुखं सौम्यं सर्वप्राणिसुखावहम् ।
दक्षिणं भीमसंकाशं रौद्रं संहरति प्रजाः ॥

meaning.en: My western face is gentle and brings happiness to all beings; the southern one is terrible and fierce, and it withdraws creatures at the end.

verses.text:
जटिलो ब्रह्मचारी च लोकानां हितकाम्यया ।
देवकार्यार्थसिद्ध्यर्थं पिनाकं मे करे स्थितम् ॥

meaning.en: I am matted-haired and a celibate student, wishing the good of the worlds; to accomplish the gods' purposes the Pinaka bow rests in my hand.

verses.text:
इन्द्रेण च पुरा वज्रं क्षिप्तं श्रीकाङ्क्षिणा मम ।
दग्ध्वा कण्ठं तु तद्यातं तेन श्रीकण्ठता मम ॥

meaning.en: Long ago Indra, longing for glory, hurled his thunderbolt at me; it burned my throat and passed on, and so I am called Shrikantha.

verses.text: उमोवाच

meaning.en: Uma said:

verses.text:
वाहनेषु प्रभूतेषु श्रीमत्स्वन्येषु सत्सु ते ।
कथं गोवृषभो देव वाहनत्वमुपागतः ॥

meaning.en: Though you have many splendid mounts, O god, why did the bull, the ox, become your vehicle?

verses.text: महेश्वर उवाच

meaning.en: Maheshvara said:

verses.text:
सुरभीं ससृजे ब्रह्मामृतधेनुं पयोमुचम् ।
सा सृष्टा बहुधा जाता क्षरमाणा पयोऽमृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Brahma created Surabhi, the nectar-cow giving milk; once created she multiplied, and flowed with milk that was nectar.

verses.text:
तस्या वत्समुखोत्सृष्टः फेनो मद्गात्रमागतः ।
ततो दग्धा मया गावो नानावर्णत्वमागताः ॥

meaning.en: Froth thrown from the mouth of her calf fell on my body; I burned the cows with it, and they took on many colours.

verses.text:
ततोऽहं लोकगुरुणा शमं नीतोऽर्थवेदिना ।
वृषं चेमं ध्वजार्थं मे ददौ वाहनमेव च ॥

meaning.en: Then the teacher of the worlds, knower of meanings, calmed me, and gave me this bull both as my banner and as my mount.

verses.text: उमोवाच

meaning.en: Uma said:

verses.text:
निवासा बहुरूपास्ते विश्वरूपगुणान्विताः ।
तांश्च संत्यज्य भगवञ्श्मशाने रमसे कथम् ॥

meaning.en: You have many dwellings, rich with every kind of excellence; why, revered one, do you abandon them and take pleasure in the cremation ground?

verses.text:
केशास्थिकलिले भीमे कपालघटसंकुले ।
गृध्रगोमायुकलिले चिताग्निशतसंकुले ॥

meaning.en: It is dreadful, thick with hair and bones, crowded with skull-pots, full of vultures and jackals, packed with hundreds of funeral fires.

verses.text:
अशुचौ मांसकलिले वसाशोणितकर्दमे ।
विनिकीर्णामिषचये शिवानादविनादिते ॥

meaning.en: It is unclean, muddy with flesh, fat and blood, strewn with heaps of meat, and loud with the howling of jackals.

verses.text: महेश्वर उवाच

meaning.en: Maheshvara said:

verses.text:
मेध्यान्वेषी महीं कृत्स्नां विचरामि निशास्वहम् ।
न च मेध्यतरं किंचिच्छ्मशानादिह विद्यते ॥

meaning.en: Seeking what is pure, I roam the whole earth at night, and nothing here is purer than the cremation ground.

verses.text:
तेन मे सर्ववासानां श्मशाने रमते मनः ।
न्यग्रोधशाखासंछन्ने निर्भुक्तस्रग्विभूषिते ॥

meaning.en: So, of all dwellings, my mind delights in the cremation ground, shaded by banyan branches and adorned with discarded garlands.

verses.text:
तत्र चैव रमन्ते मे भूतसंघाः शुभानने ।
न च भूतगणैर्देवि विनाहं वस्तुमुत्सहे ॥

meaning.en: My hosts of spirits also take pleasure there, lovely-faced one, and I cannot bear to live without those spirit-bands, goddess.

verses.text:
एष वासो हि मे मेध्यः स्वर्गीयश्च मतो हि मे ।
पुण्यः परमकश्चैव मेध्यकामैरुपास्यते ॥

meaning.en: This dwelling is pure to me and I regard it as heavenly; it is holy and supreme, and is resorted to by those who seek purity.

verses.text: उमोवाच

meaning.en: Uma said:

verses.text:
भगवन्सर्वभूतेश सर्वधर्मभृतां वर ।
पिनाकपाणे वरद संशयो मे महानयम् ॥

meaning.en: Lord, master of all beings, best of those who uphold dharma, wielder of the Pinaka, giver of boons, I have a great doubt.

verses.text:
अयं मुनिगणः सर्वस्तपस्तप इति प्रभो ।
तपोन्वेषकरो लोके भ्रमते विविधाकृतिः ॥

meaning.en: Lord, all this company of sages, saying 'austerity, austerity', wanders the world in varied guises seeking austerity.

verses.text:
अस्य चैवर्षिसंघस्य मम च प्रियकाम्यया ।
एतं ममेह संदेहं वक्तुमर्हस्यरिंदम ॥

meaning.en: For the sake of pleasing this band of seers and me, you should resolve this doubt of mine, subduer of foes.

verses.text:
धर्मः किंलक्षणः प्रोक्तः कथं वाचरितुं नरैः ।
शक्यो धर्ममविन्दद्भिर्धर्मज्ञ वद मे प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: What is dharma said to be like, and how can people who do not know it practise it? Tell me, O knower of dharma, Lord.

verses.text: नारद उवाच

meaning.en: Narada said:

verses.text:
ततो मुनिगणः सर्वस्तां देवीं प्रत्यपूजयत् ।
वाग्भिरृग्भूषितार्थाभिः स्तवैश्चार्थविदां वर ॥

meaning.en: Then the whole company of sages honoured the goddess with words and praises rich in meaning, addressing the best of those who know meanings.

verses.text: महेश्वर उवाच

meaning.en: Maheshvara said:

verses.text:
अहिंसा सत्यवचनं सर्वभूतानुकम्पनम् ।
शमो दानं यथाशक्ति गार्हस्थ्यो धर्म उत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: Non-violence, truthful speech, compassion for all beings, tranquillity, and giving as one is able: this is the best dharma of the householder.

verses.text:
परदारेष्वसंकल्पो न्यासस्त्रीपरिरक्षणम् ।
अदत्तादानविरमो मधुमांसस्य वर्जनम् ॥

meaning.en: Having no designs on others' wives, guarding deposits and women entrusted, refraining from taking what is not given, and avoiding honey and meat.

verses.text:
एष पञ्चविधो धर्मो बहुशाखः सुखोदयः ।
देहिभिर्धर्मपरमैः कर्तव्यो धर्मसंचयः ॥

meaning.en: This fivefold dharma, with many branches and bringing happiness, should be accumulated by embodied beings who hold dharma supreme.

verses.text: उमोवाच

meaning.en: Uma said:

verses.text:
भगवन्संशयं पृष्टस्तं मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि ।
चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य यो धर्मः स्वे स्वे वर्णे गुणावहः ॥

meaning.en: Lord, being asked about my doubt, please explain to me the dharma of the four orders, which is beneficial in each order.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणे कीदृशो धर्मः क्षत्रिये कीदृशो भवेत् ।
वैश्ये किंलक्षणो धर्मः शूद्रे किंलक्षणो भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: What dharma belongs to the Brahmana, what to the Kshatriya, what is the mark of dharma for the Vaishya, and what for the Shudra?

verses.text: महेश्वर उवाच

meaning.en: Maheshvara said:

verses.text:
न्यायतस्ते महाभागे संशयः समुदीरितः ।
भूमिदेवा महाभागाः सदा लोके द्विजातयः ॥

meaning.en: Your question is rightly put, fortunate lady. The twice-born, the earthly gods, are ever greatly blessed in the world.

verses.text:
उपवासः सदा धर्मो ब्राह्मणस्य न संशयः ।
स हि धर्मार्थमुत्पन्नो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥

meaning.en: Fasting is always the Brahmana's dharma, without doubt; born for dharma, he is fit to become one with Brahman.

verses.text:
तस्य धर्मक्रिया देवि व्रतचर्या च न्यायतः ।
तथोपनयनं चैव द्विजायैवोपपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: For him, goddess, rightful dharmic acts, observance of vows, and likewise the sacred-thread initiation are fitting for the twice-born.

verses.text:
गुरुदैवतपूजार्थं स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनात्मकः ।
देहिभिर्धर्मपरमैश्चर्तव्यो धर्मसंभवः ॥

meaning.en: For worship of teachers and gods, consisting of study and repetition of the Veda, this dharmic life should be practised by those devoted to dharma.

verses.text: उमोवाच

meaning.en: Uma said:

verses.text:
भगवन्संशयो मेऽत्र तं मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि ।
चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य धर्मं हि नैपुण्येन प्रकीर्तय ॥

meaning.en: Lord, I have a doubt here; please explain it to me. Describe skilfully the dharma of the four orders.

verses.text: महेश्वर उवाच

meaning.en: Maheshvara said:

verses.text:
रहस्यश्रवणं धर्मो वेदव्रतनिषेवणम् ।
व्रतचर्यापरो धर्मो गुरुपादप्रसादनम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the secret teachings, keeping Vedic vows, devotion to observances, and pleasing the teacher's feet are dharma.

verses.text:
भैक्षचर्यापरो धर्मो धर्मो नित्योपवासिता ।
नित्यस्वाध्यायिता धर्मो ब्रह्मचर्याश्रमस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Living by begging alms, constant fasting, and constant study are dharma, as is the stage of the celibate student.

verses.text:
गुरुणा त्वभ्यनुज्ञातः समावर्तेत वै द्विजः ।
विन्देतानन्तरं भार्यामनुरूपां यथाविधि ॥

meaning.en: With the teacher's permission the twice-born should return home, and afterwards take a suitable wife according to rule.

verses.text:
शूद्रान्नवर्जनं धर्मस्तथा सत्पथसेवनम् ।
धर्मो नित्योपवासित्वं ब्रह्मचर्यं तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: Avoiding the food of a Shudra, following the good path, constant fasting and celibacy are dharma.

verses.text:
आहिताग्निरधीयानो जुह्वानः संयतेन्द्रियः ।
विघसाशी यताहारो गृहस्थः सत्यवाक्शुचिः ॥

meaning.en: The householder maintains the sacred fires, studies, offers oblations, controls his senses, eats the remains of offerings, keeps moderate food, speaks truth and is pure.

verses.text:
अतिथिव्रतता धर्मो धर्मस्त्रेताग्निधारणम् ।
इष्टीश्च पशुबन्धांश्च विधिपूर्वं समाचरेत् ॥

meaning.en: Devotion to guests and keeping the three fires are dharma; he should perform the iṣṭi and animal sacrifices rightly by the rule.

verses.text:
यज्ञश्च परमो धर्मस्तथाहिंसा च देहिषु ।
अपूर्वभोजनं धर्मो विघसाशित्वमेव च ॥

meaning.en: Sacrifice is supreme dharma, and so is non-violence toward living beings; not eating before others, and eating the remains of offerings, are dharma.

verses.text:
भुक्ते परिजने पश्चाद्भोजनं धर्म उच्यते ।
ब्राह्मणस्य गृहस्थस्य श्रोत्रियस्य विशेषतः ॥

meaning.en: Eating after the household has eaten is called dharma, especially for the learned Brahmana householder.

verses.text:
दंपत्योः समशीलत्वं धर्मश्च गृहमेधिनाम् ।
गृह्याणां चैव देवानां नित्यं पुष्पबलिक्रिया ॥

meaning.en: Husband and wife sharing the same disposition is dharma for householders, and the daily offering of flowers and gifts to the household gods.

verses.text:
नित्योपलेपनं धर्मस्तथा नित्योपवासिता ।
सुसंमृष्टोपलिप्ते च साज्यधूमोद्गमे गृहे ॥

meaning.en: Daily smearing of the floor is dharma, and likewise constant fasting, in a house well swept and smeared, with the smoke of ghee rising.

verses.text:
एष द्विजजने धर्मो गार्हस्थ्यो लोकधारणः ।
द्विजातीनां सतां नित्यं सदैवैष प्रवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: This householder dharma among the twice-born upholds the world; among good twice-born people it always continues.

verses.text:
यस्तु क्षत्रगतो देवि त्वया धर्म उदीरितः ।
तमहं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि तं मे शृणु समाहिता ॥

meaning.en: Now the dharma you asked about, that of the Kshatriya, goddess, I will tell you; listen to it with attention.

verses.text:
क्षत्रियस्य स्मृतो धर्मः प्रजापालनमादितः ।
निर्दिष्टफलभोक्ता हि राजा धर्मेण युज्यते ॥

meaning.en: The Kshatriya's dharma is declared to be first of all protecting subjects; a king enjoys his appointed reward when joined to dharma.

verses.text:
प्रजाः पालयते यो हि धर्मेण मनुजाधिपः ।
तस्य धर्मार्जिता लोकाः प्रजापालनसंचिताः ॥

meaning.en: A ruler of men who protects his subjects with dharma wins worlds earned by dharma and gathered by protecting them.

verses.text:
तत्र राज्ञः परो धर्मो दमः स्वाध्याय एव च ।
अग्निहोत्रपरिस्पन्दो दानाध्ययनमेव च ॥

meaning.en: Then the king's highest dharma is self-restraint and study, tending the Agnihotra fire, giving and learning.

verses.text:
यज्ञोपवीतधारणं यज्ञो धर्मक्रियास्तथा ।
भृत्यानां भरणं धर्मः कृते कर्मण्यमोघता ॥

meaning.en: Wearing the sacred thread, sacrifice, dharmic acts, maintaining dependants, and making his deeds fruitful are dharma.

verses.text:
सम्यग्दण्डे स्थितिर्धर्मो धर्मो वेदक्रतुक्रियाः ।
व्यवहारस्थितिर्धर्मः सत्यवाक्यरतिस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Holding firm to just punishment, the Vedic rites and sacrifices, steadiness in legal procedure, and love of truthful speech are dharma.

verses.text:
आर्तहस्तप्रदो राजा प्रेत्य चेह महीयते ।
गोब्राह्मणार्थे विक्रान्तः संग्रामे निधनं गतः ।
अश्वमेधजिताँल्लोकान्प्राप्नोति त्रिदिवालये ॥

meaning.en: A king who gives a hand to the distressed is honoured here and hereafter. One who fights for cows and Brahmanas and falls in battle gains the worlds won by the horse sacrifice, in heaven.

verses.text:
वैश्यस्य सततं धर्मः पाशुपाल्यं कृषिस्तथा ।
अग्निहोत्रपरिस्पन्दो दानाध्ययनमेव च ॥

meaning.en: The Vaishya's constant dharma is herding cattle and farming, tending the Agnihotra fire, giving and learning.

verses.text:
वाणिज्यं सत्पथस्थानमातिथ्यं प्रशमो दमः ।
विप्राणां स्वागतं त्यागो वैश्यधर्मः सनातनः ॥

meaning.en: Trade, keeping to the good path, hospitality, calm, self-restraint, welcoming Brahmanas and generosity are the Vaishya's eternal dharma.

verses.text:
तिलान्गन्धान्रसांश्चैव न विक्रीणीत वै क्वचित् ।
वणिक्पथमुपासीनो वैश्यः सत्पथमाश्रितः ॥

meaning.en: He should never sell sesame, perfumes or juices; the Vaishya who follows the merchant's road should keep to the good path.

verses.text:
सर्वातिथ्यं त्रिवर्गस्य यथाशक्ति यथार्हतः ।
शूद्रधर्मः परो नित्यं शुश्रूषा च द्विजातिषु ॥

meaning.en: Hospitality to all, to the extent of his means and as is fitting, applies to the three aims of life. The Shudra's highest dharma is ever service to the twice-born.

verses.text:
स शूद्रः संशिततपाः सत्यसंधो जितेन्द्रियः ।
शुश्रूषन्नतिथिं प्राप्तं तपः संचिनुते महत् ॥

meaning.en: That Shudra of keen austerity, true to his word and master of his senses, gathers great austerity by serving a guest who has come.

verses.text:
त्यक्तहिंसः शुभाचारो देवताद्विजपूजकः ।
शूद्रो धर्मफलैरिष्टैः संप्रयुज्येत बुद्धिमान् ॥

meaning.en: Free from violence, of good conduct, honouring gods and the twice-born, the wise Shudra is joined to the desired fruits of dharma.

verses.text:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य शोभने ।
एकैकस्येह सुभगे किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: All this has been told to you, lovely one, of the dharma of the four orders, each in turn. What else do you wish to hear, fortunate lady?
